assessment.nobel_worthiness: Ionizable lipid nanoparticles made nucleic-acid drugs deliverable in vivo and underpin siRNA therapy (patisiran) and mRNA vaccines. It is a clear case of molecular design (pKa-tuned lipids, self-assembly, endosomal escape) that changed what clinicians can do, which is the test I weigh most heavily.
assessment.attribution: Cullis and colleagues in Vancouver (Madden, Hope, MacLachlan) developed the early lipid-nanoparticle and ionizable-lipid formulations; Anderson and Langer contributed combinatorial lipid libraries and later delivery work. A three-person configuration of Cullis, Madden and Anderson is defensible but leaves out Hope, MacLachlan and Langer, so credit is contestable.
assessment.maturity: Decades of work with approved products, large-scale clinical and pandemic validation, and independent confirmation. Timely: the 2023 Medicine prize recognized nucleoside-modified mRNA, so the delivery chemistry is the natural complementary chemistry recognition.
uncertainties: Exact split of credit among Cullis, Madden, Hope, MacLachlan and Anderson/Langer is uncertain to me and I have not verified patent or priority details.
Risk that the committee views it as pharmaceutical formulation rather than fundamental chemistry.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Targeted protein degradation with PROTACs and molecular glues turns small molecules into inducers of proximity that hijack the ubiquitin-proteasome system, enabling pharmacology against targets previously considered undruggable. Strong design principle and rapid spread across chemical biology and drug discovery.
assessment.attribution: Crews and Deshaies conceived and built the first PROTACs; Handa identified cereblon as the thalidomide target, explaining molecular-glue degraders. Ciulli, Sakamoto, Gray and others made important contributions (VHL ligands, degrader design), so the three-person limit forces difficult omissions.
assessment.maturity: Multiple degraders are in clinical trials with early clinical validation, but approval of a PROTAC drug is still pending. Mechanistic understanding is strong, although clinical impact is still maturing; arguably slightly early but close.
uncertainties: Whether clinical outcomes will fully vindicate the concept is not yet settled.
Credit between PROTAC inventors and the cereblon/molecular-glue line may need to be separated; the thalidomide mechanism (Handa, Ito) may be the part more ready for recognition.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Nanopore sensing of single nucleic-acid molecules is a general single-molecule readout principle that became a commercial long-read sequencing technology. It combines protein engineering, membrane chemistry and electrical detection, and has widespread use in genomics, diagnostics and field analysis.
assessment.attribution: Kasianowicz, Brandt, Branton and Deamer demonstrated polynucleotide translocation through alpha-hemolysin in 1996; Deamer and Akeson pursued nucleotide discrimination and enzyme-ratcheted reading; Bayley engineered pores and supplied the molecular design. Branton, to my recollection, has died (uncertain), which would remove him from consideration.
assessment.maturity: Mature: robust independent confirmation, widely deployed instruments and a long record of applications. Recognition is arguably well-timed.
uncertainties: Attribution between the original translocation demonstration, pore engineering and the sequencing-by-enzyme-ratchet development is contested.
Whether the committee sees it as chemistry or as physics/biotechnology.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Base editors chemically convert one base into another (cytidine and adenosine deaminases fused to Cas9 nickase) without double-strand breaks, a direct application of chemical mechanism to genome editing. It has already reached the clinic and is a very clear example of a tool changing what researchers and clinicians can actually do.
assessment.attribution: Liu led the conceptual and experimental development, with Komor and Gaudelli as the lead trainees, and Nishida and Kondo reported a related cytidine-deaminase system at nearly the same time. A single-laureate award to Liu is clean, though the contributions of the near-simultaneous independent work complicate it.
assessment.maturity: Rapid adoption with first clinical-stage results; the technology is still evolving but the principle is well established. Some risk that it is considered too recent, and that CRISPR was recognized in 2020 so this is derivative of that.
uncertainties: Early clinical durability and safety data are limited.
Possibility that prime editing (a separate ballot entry) is treated as part of a combined Liu recognition.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The recognition that cells organize biochemistry through liquid-liquid phase separation (P granules, nucleoli, signaling condensates) reshaped cell biology and is conceptually appealing for a molecular materials viewpoint (multivalency, weak interactions, materials properties).
assessment.attribution: Brangwynne and Hyman showed liquid-like P granules in 2009; Rosen and colleagues established multivalent signaling-protein condensates (2012); Pappu and Mittag provided physical-chemical frameworks. The three-person set is plausible but excludes theoretical and biophysical contributors.
assessment.maturity: Highly influential but contested at the level of physiological significance and definitions of condensates. Not yet fully mature for a prize whose criterion is a robust, confirmed discovery.
uncertainties: Debate over which in vivo condensates truly arise by phase separation.
Whether the field is better placed in Physiology or Medicine.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Genetic code expansion via orthogonal tRNA/synthetase pairs allows site-specific incorporation of unnatural amino acids in living cells, offering programmable chemical control over proteins. It is a molecular design tool that is broadly used in protein engineering, biomaterials and therapeutics.
assessment.attribution: Schultz, with Wang, demonstrated the first eukaryotic and bacterial unnatural amino-acid incorporation systems; Chin extended to multiple codons, quadruplet decoding and organismal engineering; Yokoyama and Mehl contributed pairs. Fair configuration possible but others omitted.
assessment.maturity: Well confirmed over two decades with extensive use, though therapeutic translation (e.g., antibody-drug conjugates) is moderate. Timely.
uncertainties: Dispute over which founding contributions are decisive.
Impact may be seen as mostly a specialist tool.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Native chemical ligation allows chemoselective joining of unprotected peptides and enabled total chemical synthesis and semisynthesis of proteins, including site-specific modifications. A foundational method for protein chemistry and biomaterials design.
assessment.attribution: Dawson, Muir, Kent and colleagues published the 1994 native chemical ligation paper; Muir expanded to expressed protein ligation; Danishefsky, Brik and Liu extended to complex targets. The primary trio is natural but not unique.
assessment.maturity: Very mature and widely used, which may mean the moment has partially passed or that the recognition is overdue.
uncertainties: Attribution within the 1994 paper and the role of Kent as originator of the broader chemical protein synthesis program.
Whether competitive visibility compared with newer technologies is sufficient.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: DNA origami and programmable DNA nanostructures provide nanometer-precise molecular assembly with arbitrary shapes and addressable positions, strongly connected to my interest in designed assembly and nanoscale platforms for sensing and drug delivery.
assessment.attribution: Rothemund introduced scaffolded DNA origami in 2006, building on Seeman's DNA nanotechnology (Seeman is not in the credited list); Shih, Yin and Yan expanded to 3D and dynamic systems. Credit is complicated by the foundational role of non-listed pioneers.
assessment.maturity: Established as a field with broad use, but real-world applications beyond research tools are still emerging. Impact may be viewed as ahead of translational maturity.
uncertainties: Foundational contribution of pioneers outside the credited names may make a fair prize awkward.
